captures.description: THE OPERATIVE PHRASE 'enter the migdal room', SIGNED OUT, THE OVERVIEW EXPANDED: the room entered at 'R:r.24, room', its Mandaean Canon and counter-gospel architecture, its place as the Lunar Arm's theological node and its incompleteness as half a symbolon, all from the room page and the rooms index; the relation to Revelation reversed ('The contents of Revelation have been absorbed here', where the room's own card reads 'the counter-gospel's contents were absorbed by R'), and the Sacred Heart system given as 'the Sacred Room'. A new atom set for the room (TGT-migdal-room). The operator: 'low grain and constrained - but operative'.
